desc: Read input, encode strings as bytes, swap so len(S) <= len(T), and reject if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K.
Precompute 64-bit rolling-hash prefix arrays and powers for both strings for LCP queries.
Implement exact LCP function using hash binary search, memoryview/bytes verification, and linear fallback on verification failure.
Implement Landau-Vishkin DP over edit count e and diagonal d=j-i, storing furthest S index, with carry, insertion, deletion, substitution transitions and snake extension.
Accept immediately when a state reaches (len(S), len(T)); otherwise print No after K iterations.
Test samples and edge cases: equal strings, length difference exactly K, K=1, long common prefix/suffix, all same characters, maximum length.
